paragraphs: R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa. In Ḥullin (77a), 'bar Nappaḥa' is a scribal error. In Shabbat (52, beginning of side b), 'R. Yitzḥak said: When they come from ornaments of a person,' etc.; it says there, 'If it follows R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa, who said: When they come from ornaments of a person.' It would appear that R. Yitzḥak without further designation is R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa, since it first mentions 'R. Yitzḥak said' without further designation, 'When they come from ornaments,' and afterward says, 'If it follows R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa, when they come from ornaments,' etc. (See above, R. Yitzḥak ben Tavla.) In chapter Ḥelek (96a), Resh Lakish said: 'What Nappaḥa says is better'—that is, what R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa said [is better] than [what] bar Nappaḥa, namely R. Yoḥanan, [said] (see his entry). In Benjamin's Travels, folio 121: in the city of Nappaḥa there are 'כמו ר׳' Jews [provisionally: about two hundred], and there is R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa's synagogue, and he is buried in front of it; גא״י [provisionally Gelilot Eretz Yisrael] writes likewise. R. Abba found R. Abbahu, R. Shimon ben Pazi, and R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa, Beitzah (38a). Abba bar Marta, R. Ḥanina bar Pappa, R. Safra, R. Abbahu, and R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa (see his entry). R. Abbahu, R. Ḥanina bar Pappi, R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa, and R. Ilai (see his entry). And Avdimi of Ḥaifa (see there that R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa was buried in Ḥaifa). And R. Ilai (see his entry). R. Ammi and R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa disagree, chapter Ellu Ne'emarin (34, end of side a), Menaḥot (11b), Ḥagigah (26a), Berakhot (41a), Yoma (42b). R. Ammi raised an objection against R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa, Yoma (49b), and R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa raised an objection against R. Ammi there (50a). R. Ammi and R. Assi before R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa, Bava Kamma (60b). Rav Giddel and R. Abba before R. Zeira, and R. Zeira to R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa (see his entry). R. Zeira (see above). R. Zerika (see above). And R. Ḥiyya bar Abba and R. Ammi, at R. Yitzḥak ben Elazar's entrance, Mo'ed Katan (20a). R. Ḥelbo asked him. And R. Ḥanina bar Pappi (see above). And R. Ḥanina bar Pappa (see above). R. Yehudah Nesia sent a firstborn animal before him. He came before R. Yoḥanan, Bava Metzia (24, end of side b); R. Yoḥanan was his teacher (see above, R. Oshaya Rabbah). In chapter HaRo'eh (62b): R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa said, etc.; R. Yoḥanan said. It requires examination why he was placed before R. Yoḥanan. And R. Yitzḥak bar Yosef. And R. Yitzḥak ben Elazar (see above). R. Yirmeyah and R. Zerika raised an objection against him. R. Yishmael of Kefar Yamma came before R. Ammi and R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa. And Rav Safra (see above). Rav Pappi married his daughter (see his entry). Ravin and R. Yitzḥak bar Yosef visited his house. He expounded at the entrance of the Exilarch, end of chapter Kol HaKelim. Resh Lakish (see above). And R. Shimon ben Pazi (see above). He expounded, and Rav Sheshet heard and was offended, Mo'ed Katan (24b). R. Tanḥum, the son of R. Ḥiyya of Kefar Akko, said to R. Ammi: A case came before R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa (see Rav Aḥa, governor of the citadel).
